messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick sync — Databricks connector + Aurora-Accel HW demo + marketplace listing. Partner asked for joint demo week of May 10. Need: compatibility matrix, perf numbers (QPS + 95p latency), installer + test dataset, embargo timeline. Who can own each? cc @Sam @Marco @Lena
Sam (Eng): I can own perf numbers and test harness. Need exact model/quant settings from runtime. What's the target latency? Also can we get access to partner test hw next Tue?
Priya (Partnerships): Target: 95p <120ms for small-embed (128d) and 95p <350ms for 512d ops at batch 8. Partner to provide dev firmware slot by Mon. Manifest draft:```yaml
name: redwood-databricks-aurora-adapter
version: 0.1.0
integrations:
  - databricks
  - aurora-accel
compatibility:
  databricks_runtime: '12.2'
  firmware_min: '3.4.1'
```
Marco (Solutions): I'll create the installer and quickstart. Need driver versions and an install smoke test. Can someone add 'install-smoke' to test plan?
Jen (QA): Added smoke plan to test repo. Minimal ingest command: `./ingest --host $HW_IP --dataset sample-1m --batch 128`. We'll collect token counts and p95 latency. Also tagging a tiny eval set for quality checks.
Lena (GTM): On comms: partner wants coordinated press + marketplace banner. Legal needs 72h for review. Can we freeze message copy by May 7? Also who owns marketplace listing assets (screenshots, logo)?
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing created in staging: staging/listings/redwood-databricks-aurora-adapter. Status: pending assets.
Priya (Partnerships): Owners confirmed: Sam=perf/test, Marco=installer, Jen=qa, Lena=announce, Priya=partner sync. Freeze assets by May 7. Partner access requested for Tues. Next check-in Thurs 10am PT. :eyes:
